column1: # Neighborly vendored-skill provenance — read by /nei-skills-update to refetch + re-prefix.

#   path=auto      → single-skill repo; the updater finds the lone SKILL.md.
#   commit=<sha>   → pinned upstream commit; refetch checks out exactly this SHA.
